test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into our segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Many of my friends / spoke highly / of a film / which I have seen it yesterday.

options.text: which I have seen it yesterday

solution:
The correct answer is **"which I have seen it yesterday"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There is a problem with the tense in this sentence:
 
 
• The sentence is in the **past tense** as we can see yesterday in the sentence. We can't use **have + third form** of the verb in the **past tense.** We have to use the **2nd form of the verb** in the sentence.
 
• We must use **saw** in the place of **have seen**. 
 
• Look at the following sentences:
 
 
• I **went** to watch football yesterday. (right)
 
• I **have gone** to watch football yesterday. (wrong)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *Many of my friends spoke highly of a film which I** saw** yesterday.*
